title: The Personhood of the Holy Spirit
definition: The personhood of the Holy Spirit means that the Spirit is not a mere influence, but a divine Person who speaks, teaches, wills, guides, comforts, convicts, and can be grieved.
summary: The Spirit acts personally throughout Scripture. He teaches truth, bears witness to Christ, gives gifts, intercedes, and works in the hearts of God's people.
christFocus: The Spirit personally leads believers to Christ, glorifies Christ, and forms Christlike character within them.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit acts personally throughout Scripture. He teaches truth, bears witness to Christ, gives gifts, intercedes, and works in the hearts of God's people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
